description: Curated 9-item benchmark test dataset (7 public DLA PUB LOG catalog items + 2 synthetic seed items) covering all 5 recommendation categories and human-review edge cases.
license_or_reuse_status: Public domain (U.S. Government PUB LOG / USGS) and CC0-1.0 (synthetic operational and BOM records)

test_cases.scenario: Unserviceable radar printed wiring board with confirmed PUB LOG copper cladding and tin-lead plating specification -> Reclaim
test_cases.source_notes: Item, identification codes, classification, and MRC FEAT text extracted from DLA PUB LOG (P_FLIS_NSN.CSV, V_FLIS_IDENTIFICATION.CSV, V_H2_FSG.CSV, V_H2_FSC.CSV, V_H6_NAME_INC.CSV, V_CHARACTERISTICS.CSV). Operational lifecycle condition and nominal mass percentages are synthetic (CC0-1.0).

test_cases.scenario: False-positive lexical match on 'LG OF LEAD' (electrical wire lead length) and unmatched INC 77777 -> Manual Review
test_cases.source_notes: Real PUB LOG edge case discovered during Stage 2 and Priority 4 ingestion: NIIN 000030837 matched keyword 'lead' on '16.750 IN. APPROX. LG OF LEAD' (wire length) and carries INC 77777 (not found in V_H6_NAME_INC.CSV). Validates FR 6 and FR 9 human-review routing.
